summary: Four-pose reference sheet for Payload Bouncer, the Club DB security bouncer responsible for receiving, securing, and moving payloads. Shows neutral standing, package inspection, carry/transport, and handoff poses with signature cargo box and payload props.

character: Bearded adult man with medium-brown skin
Wears a black baseball cap and black Club DB security polo
Friendly but focused facial expression and posture
costume: Black short-sleeve polo with Club DB patch on the chest
Black trousers with belt and black work shoes
Employee badge on a lanyard labeled PAYLOAD BOUNCER
signature_props: Cardboard or plastic cargo box with payload contents
Hand truck or trolley for moving multiple payloads
Shipping label, manifest, or intake tag for tracking
poses: 1: Neutral standing holding a small payload box
2: Package inspection pose checking a label or manifest
3: Carry/transport pose moving a box or rolling a hand truck
4: Handoff pose passing a secured payload to another worker
color_notes: Dominant black uniform with white badge text
Neutral brown/tan cargo boxes and white paper labels
Subtle green check marks or red X marks as status accents

positive_constraints: Always include a payload box, package, or cargo prop in every pose
Keep the black cap, black Club DB polo, black trousers, and black work shoes
Maintain friendly but focused body language and clear facial expression
Retain the lanyard badge labeled PAYLOAD BOUNCER
negative_constraints: Do not omit the payload or cargo prop from any pose
Do not replace the cargo with unrelated items such as weapons or food
Do not add unrelated accessories, alternate costumes, or backstory details
Do not alter the Club DB patch or badge text
